item.text:
Small shop order utilities: totals line items, applies discount codes, computes an average, formats orders.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined), causing a `TypeError`. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides a quantity-weighted total by the number of line items, so it is not the average individual item price when quantities exceed 1. It also returns `NaN` for an empty list.
